The timing of the garden project starting on Saturday morning has no bearing on whether Dara and Cleo were on different teams; these are unrelated facts about scheduling versus team assignment.

If the project began early Saturday morning, it is natural for activity to have built up by midmorning that same day, making B a plausible continuation of A.
